name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.61-beta “Paris” (build 62): four more moot courts, and Pass On.
• Moot Madrid, the Nuremberg Moot Court, the Nelson Mandela World Human Rights Moot and the Christof Heyns African Human Rights Moot — each with its citation forms and index.
• Multilingual moots: New Moot Matter asks for the language of the memorials (English, French or Spanish).
• Pass On to Next Year’s Team (File ▸ Export): a copy of the moot matter with its legal authorities, files, short forms, tags and summaries — without the record, your submissions or the AI Protocol.
• Spanish legal output: matters whose exhibits are “Documento” or “Anexo” cite with párr. and write a Spanish List of Exhibits and List of Authorities.
• Ukrainian: “tribunal” and “list of authorities” now read as Ukrainian arbitration practitioners write them.
